newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Ranbaxy, Croslands to merge.
newsitem.headline: India's Ranbaxy, Croslands to merge.

text.p: Indian pharmaceuticals firm Ranbaxy Laboratories Ltd said on Monday it would merge with Croslands Research Laboratories Ltd.
A Ranbaxy spokeswoman said three Ranbaxy shares would be offered for seven shares in Croslands.
"The swap ratio is three shares of Ranbaxy for seven shares of Croslands," the spokeswoman told Reuters following a meeting of Ranbaxy's board of directors in the Indian capital.
She said the firms would address a joint news conference in Bombay on Tuesday.
Ranbaxy shares climbed 8.75 rupees, or 1.5 percent, to end at 605 rupees on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) on Monday. Croslands' shares closed 13 rupees, or 5.4 percent, higher at 253 rupees.
